def VTask.map {α β} (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) : Matroid β :=
  let e : M.E → f '' M.E := fun x => ⟨f x, by { rw [Set.mem_image], existsi x, simp }⟩
  let he_inj : Function.Injective e := by
    intro x y h
    apply hf
    · simp [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at x
    · simp [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at y
    · apply_fun f at h
      simp at h
  let he_surj : Function.Surjective e := by
    intro y
    rcases y with ⟨a, ha⟩
    existsi ⟨a, ha⟩
    simp
  let he_bio : Function.Bijective e := ⟨he_inj, he_surj⟩
  Matroid.copy M e he_bio
